verdict.rationale: Runpod documents its own ways to get stored data out over open, standard paths. Network volumes are reachable through an S3-protocol-compatible API without launching a Pod. runpodctl can transfer files between your system and Runpod. Data egress is free, which lowers the cost of leaving, and workloads use standard container images pulled from any compatible registry. missing for 10: a documented full-account export (templates, endpoint configs, billing and usage history), explicit export-format and offboarding docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Runpod provides an S3-protocol compatible API for direct access to your network volumes.
transfer files between your system and Runpod
Pods are billed by the second for compute and storage, with no fees for data ingress or egress.
Pull from any compatible container registry such as Docker Hub, GitHub Container Registry, or Amazon ECR.
